title: A Concept-Based Interpretable Framework for Clinical Text-based Prediction via Token-Concept Attention without Concept Supervision
abstract: arXiv:2611.13564v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Objective: Concept-based interpretation has emerged as a promising approach for explaining blackbox models using human-understandable, high-level concepts. However, most existing methods require annotated concept labels to train the model to identify concepts in the input, and obtaining such annotations in clinical text is often expensive. This study aims to enable concept-based interpretation for language models without concept supervision on clinical prediction tasks. Methods: We propose a novel framework that enables concept-based interpretation without concept supervision through a tailored cross-attention bottleneck. Clinical text and the text descriptions of medical concepts are first tokenized and embedded by a pretrained language model. translated_title: 一种基于概念的可解释框架：通过无需概念监督的词元-概念注意力实现临床文本预测
translated_abstract: 目的：基于概念的解释已成为解释黑盒模型的一种有前景的方法，它利用人类可理解的高层概念来解释模型。然而，大多数现有方法需要带标注的概念标签来训练模型识别输入中的概念，而在临床文本中获取此类标注往往成本高昂。本研究旨在使语言模型在临床预测任务中无需概念监督即可实现基于概念的解释。方法：我们提出了一种新颖的框架，通过定制的交叉注意力瓶颈，在无需概念监督的情况下实现基于概念的解释。临床文本和医学概念的文本描述首先由预训练语言模型进行分词和嵌入。然后，交叉注意力模块为每个文本词元估计每个概念的存在情况，生成概念相关性分数，以捕捉概念在整个临床记录中的参与方式。这些分数……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种无需概念标注监督的可解释框架，通过定制交叉注意力瓶颈机制，利用预训练语言模型估计临床文本词元与医学概念之间的相关性，从而在临床预测任务中实现基于概念的黑盒模型解释。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel interpretable framework that enables concept-based explanation without concept supervision, using a tailored token-concept cross-attention bottleneck built on a pretrained language model to estimate concept relevance in clinical text prediction tasks.
